name: codeology-platform
description: Codeology curriculum, product shell and assessment platform

scripts.check:content: npm run python -- scripts/validate_content_sources.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_shell.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_home.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_lesson.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_glossary.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_catalog.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_skill_map.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_about.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_credits.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_assessment_charter.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_cv_analysis.py && npm run python -- scripts/validate_codeology_auth.py && npm run python -- scripts/audit_codeology_content.py && npm run python -- scripts/audit_lessons.py && npm run python -- scripts/audit_certifications.py && npm run python -- scripts/backfill_certification_references.py --check && npm run python -- scripts/debias_certification_questions.py --check && npm run python -- scripts/build_readme_i18n.py --check && npm run python -- scripts/run_translation_workflow_tests.py
scripts.test:cv-analysis: node scripts/test_cv_analysis_engine.mjs && node scripts/test_cv_server_contract.mjs && node scripts/test_cv_api_errors.cjs && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_cv_analysis.py
scripts.test:codeology: npm run python -- scripts/test_validate_content_sources.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_upstream_intake.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_shell.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_home.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_lesson.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_glossary.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_catalog.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_skill_map.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_about.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_credits.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_assessment_charter.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_cv_analysis.py && node scripts/test_cv_analysis_engine.mjs && node scripts/test_cv_server_contract.mjs && node scripts/test_cv_api_errors.cjs && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_auth.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_audit_codeology_content.py && npm run python -- scripts/test_codeology_author_scenario_skill.py
scripts.check:precommit: npm run check:skills && npm run check:provenance && npm run check:shell && npm run check:home && npm run check:lesson && npm run check:glossary && npm run check:catalog && npm run check:skill-map && npm run check:about && npm run check:credits && npm run check:assessment-charter && npm run check:cv-analysis && npm run check:auth && npm run check:codeology-content && npm run python -- scripts/audit_lessons.py && npm run python -- scripts/audit_certifications.py
scripts.test: npm run check:content && npm run check:skills && npm run test:codeology && npm run test:certifications
scripts.ci:strict: npm run ci && npm run check:legacy-quiz-order
scripts.test:api: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m unittest discover -s apps/api/tests -t apps/api -v
scripts.test:migration: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:web:e2e
scripts.ci:migration: npm run check:route-parity && npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run typecheck:migration && npm run build:migration
scripts.ci:all: npm run ci && npm run ci:migration && npm run test:web:e2e
scripts.typecheck:migration: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m compileall -q apps/api/app
scripts.build:web: npm run build:migration-content && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build:migration: npm run build:web && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m compileall -q apps/api/app
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run ci:all && npx --yes vercel@latest deploy
scripts.deploy:production: npm run ci:all && npx --yes vercel@latest deploy --prod
